section_summary.extract_value: This section describes The International Cognitive Ability Resource (ICAR), a measure designed to assess general cognitive abilities. The ICAR consists of 16 items covering letter and number series, matrix reasoning, three-dimensional rotation, and verbal reasoning, with participants given 18 minutes to complete it. The dependent measure was the number of correctly solved items, with descriptive statistics provided (M = 9.17, SD = 3.57, range = 2–15).
